responsibility: Declares a small registry for object files known to the gm2 toolchain. It provides initialization and destruction of a file-object set plus routines to register an object and test whether an object has already been seen by its physical filesystem identity, helping avoid duplicate linkage or repeated processing of the same object file reached through different paths.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of ObjectFiles: it exposes the opaque FileObjects type and registration/query lifecycle routines, while ObjectFiles.mod implements how object identity is determined and stored.
